_about: Sewing with Big Ma, the prototypes (proto-sewing, 2 Nov 2026; build/reports/designs/sewing.md and its critique, the sewing section of games-at-a-glance-2026-11-01.md): the words and lines the four sewing games need that the family has not recorded yet. Every one is an English placeholder (kutchi: null), to record; build/lang/import_modes.mjs turns each word into a to-record entry (pos: its part of speech where it isn't a noun) and each line into an engine meaning, so the games ask the language engine for them like any other line and it answers with the grey-italic English. Nothing here is Kutchi. Re-run node build/lang/import_all.mjs after a change.
